title: Your first save point

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Let's save this file into git.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: First, use `git add` to prepare it. Then, use `git commit -m` to save it with a short message.

hints: You need two commands to make a commit.
Type `git add notes.txt` followed by `git commit -m "Add notes"`.

predict.question: What happens when you run git commit?

choices.text: The file is uploaded to the internet
Git saves a snapshot of the prepared files with your message

predict.explanation: A commit is a local save point. Nothing is uploaded yet.

recap: `git add` prepares files. `git commit -m` saves them as a permanent snapshot.

cheatSheet.summary: Prepare a file to be saved
Save prepared files as a permanent snapshot
